title: Machine learning on CSF proteomics yields a 15-protein Alzheimer's subtype classifier
summary: CSF from 138 individuals (Abeta+/tau+ and Abeta+/tau- Alzheimer's patients and non-AD controls) was profiled by DIA mass spectrometry, identifying 2661 proteins. Machine learning selected 15 protein classifiers that distinguished the two subtypes and controls across an independent internal cohort and public external datasets. It is a biomarker panel; clinical deployment is not shown.
